data.narrative:
Heart Aerospace, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Anders and Klara Forslund, has raised $185M to date. Valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers in the same sector, with four directly comparable firms at Series B/C stages.

Two applicable methods frame the valuation range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $352M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C)—establishes a median of $1.6B with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied, as target revenue is not disclosed. The public sector trades at a 27.4x price-to-sales median, but applicability requires confidential revenue data.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $299M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median point of $1.0B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around comparable-stage scaling: early-stage methodology ($352M) versus peer-cohort positioning ($1.6B) diverge significantly. Key sensitivities include revenue trajectory, customer concentration in commercial spaceflight, and execution risk relative to comparable-stage peers.
